evidence_quotes: está havendo degradação ambiental (assoreamento do rio)
rationale: This TJSP decision concerns a possessory action brought by residents seeking to prevent municipal removal from a permanent preservation area (APP) / environmental protection area (APA) where occupation is causing river siltation ('assoreamento do rio'). Because the dispute directly addresses riparian environmental protection and physical degradation of a river rather than household water/sanitation utility access, both labels are WATER, governance_category_21 is environmental_protection, and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false.
